name: Standard Matte Canvas
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Printed on high-quality 330 GSM canvas media for vibrant colors and sharp details
    - Mounted on durable kiln-dried poplar and finger-jointed pine stretcher bars
    - Ready to hang with included sawtooth hanger
    - Fade-resistant print designed for long-lasting display
    - Thickness: 1.25 in (3.17 cm)

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in multiple vertical, horizontal, and square formats.
    📌 Note: There might be a ±5% deviation due to manual measurement and production processes.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Perfect for home décor, office spaces, bedrooms, living rooms, hallways, and galleries
    - Creates an elegant focal point for any room
    - Easy to hang and display without additional framing
    - Suitable for personalized artwork, family photos, memorial designs, inspirational quotes, and custom gifts
    - Available in multiple sizes to fit various wall spaces

 

  • Care Instructions:
    - Dust gently with a soft, dry cloth
    - Do not use harsh chemicals or abrasive cleaners
    - Avoid direct contact with water or excessive moisture
    - Keep away from prolonged direct sunlight to preserve print vibrancy

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful personalized gift for birthdays, anniversaries, weddings, housewarmings, Mother's Day, Father's Day, Christmas, Valentine's Day, memorial tributes, and other special occasions.
    - Perfect for family members, friends, couples, pet lovers, and anyone who appreciates meaningful wall art and custom home décor.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3 – 4 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time:5 – 7 working days average (US)
  • Packaging:1x Canvas + Sawtooth Hanger

 

NOTE:

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.5-2 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
